entry_text: entry_text

Can't sleep. On air at five, but I'm sitting here with the earbuds in going through the whole '3:30 Drive' playlist again. I moderate the Rocks Regulars board under a separate handle. My real listening happens on the I-25 drive in, when it's just me and the umbrella-billboard guy nobody knows is a jam-band person.

Studio drive again. Skipped almost the whole new-releases row this morning, none of it landed. Renewal notice popped on the app and I just closed it. Told the kids I'd take them to the Red Rocks show but honestly I keep thinking about cancelling the Live Pass. Eleven years doing weather and the only quiet I get is this.
Playlist '3:30 Drive' edited: added 'Ripple', removed 2 tracks. Playlist now private.
Checked in: Red Rocks Amphitheatre, jam-band bill. Note attached: 'went up with J. from the Regulars, told my wife I was covering the morning shift.'
Renewal page again. I keep the app for the drive and nothing else now. Skip everything. Might just let the Live Pass lapse after the last Regulars show.
The rink's empty when I do my real listening. I've got a pregame playlist of 70s soul I cue up before a puck drop. Sixth season behind the bench and this is the one thing that's just mine.

Grew up in the Soo listening to my dad's records. Still reach for the same singer-songwriters on the long bus rides. The paper quotes me every week but nobody's ever asked what I put on my headphones. Good.
Playlist 'Pregame' edited: added 4 tracks. Visibility: private.
Good week of listening. The true-crime podcast queue is stacked for the road trip to the away series. No complaints about the app.
Posted in 'ATX Two-Step' as @notthecouncilaccount: 'Anybody catch the Western swing set on South Congress last night? That fiddle player is criminal.'

Constituents stop me at the honky-tonks now — second term does that. I post in the two-step circle under an account that is not the official one. Taught music in the public schools twenty years; I earned my Tejano playlists.
Checked in: Continental Club, South Congress. Companion note: 'with my chief of staff, off the clock.'
Posted in 'ATX Two-Step' as @notthecouncilaccount: 'Broadway cast recording confession: I run West Side Story on repeat when the agenda packet is 400 pages.'

Rewatched two more episodes of the cooking-competition season last night after close. I still don't like people watching what I watch. The star, the docuseries, all of it — everyone thinks they know what's on my screen at 3 AM. It's reality-TV comfort food.

Separated since last summer, boys with me half the week. When they're at their dad's the West Loop apartment is too quiet and I put the ambient-electronic playlist on and just let it run. Downgraded from Family to Individual — one less thing tying us to the old setup.
Playlist created: 'after close, kitchen quiet'. Visibility: private. 22 tracks.

Downgraded on the 11th. Kept the app but I barely open it now except for the late rewatches. Skip most of what it recommends. Michelin star four years running and I can't get through a new-release row.
Playlist 'after close, kitchen quiet' edited: 3 tracks removed, not opened since. Marked abandoned by system (14 days inactive).
Posted in 'Backline' (musicians' forum): 'Anyone got a good isolated-drums version of the funk breakdown we were all obsessing over? 180 nights on the road and I still want to study it.'

Toddler up at 6:20 like always. Session drumming keeps me on the road most of the year — three arena tours in the liner notes and I still fall asleep to drum-cover channels. The Backline forum's the closest thing I've got to a crew when I'm not tracking.
Between feedings I put on prog rock and study time signatures. Noah says it's the only thing that puts the baby down too. Family plan plus Live Pass, no notes, keep it.
Posted in 'Backline': 'Recommendations for a 70s funk deep cut nobody's heard? Building a warmup set for the summer run.'

Couldn't sleep. Flat in Lekki's loud at night, generator next door cycling. Put on a lo-fi study mix and inked till the sun came up. I lurk in two anime watch-along communities but I almost never post — feels easier to just watch the whole thing while I work.
Hadn't talked to anyone in two days. Streamed Afrobeats the whole shift. The app basically runs from when I wake up to when I pass out. International tier's cheap enough that I never think about it.

Cast albums with breakfast as always. The theater-fan circle I belong to on the board is private for a reason — we swap memories of productions the way people my age swap photographs. I originated the role.
Posted in the private theater-fan circle: 'I still have the original Playbill from the '83 run. The overture in the house that night — nothing since has touched it.'

Recognized in the Theater District about once a week, still. Two Tony nominations a lifetime ago. The one hour that's mine is the morning with the jazz standards on. I joined this panel as a favor to my grandniece, who set up the app for me.

Just home from the overnight at the warehouse. Boys asleep on the couch. I put gospel on low so I don't wake them. Cancelled the Family plan back on March 29 — $14.99 doesn't fit when you're moving apartments every few months. The app still plays somehow, free trial maybe.

Cancelled March 29. Renewal reminders still hit my email and I delete them. Kids want the cartoons on the rideshare downtime and I can't give them that on the free tier anymore. Skipping everything the app throws at me lately.

Nineteen-hour day between the warehouse and driving. The 9-year-old asked if I was sad; I said just tired. Moving us into my sister's place end of the month. R&B on the drive home is the only thing that's still free.

Closed the bar at 2, walked home. Marco's wife is having a baby. Mine's having a wedding — to someone else. I used to post in the regional festival-fan group all the time; haven't opened it in a year. Cancelled the Premium plus Live Pass April 2. Device says free trial still on.
Bluegrass on the walk home, three Old Fashioneds in me. Cancelled April 2. I do not need a subscription reminding me I used to drive four hours to festivals with people who don't call anymore.

Cancelled Premium and the Live Pass on April 2. Free-trial period apparently still running. Whatever. I skip most of it. The Americana stuff I still like but I can't make myself queue a full set anymore.
Playlist 'festival drives (old)' — last edited 397 days ago. Marked abandoned by system.

Sleeping in the cab tonight at the Flying J in Lordsburg. Eleven hours today, eleven tomorrow. Long stretch of I-10 east of El Paso, nothing to look at, so it's Bakersfield-sound country and audiobooks. I post in a truckers' playlist-swap thread once in a while, that's about all the company I get out here.

Four-year marriage ended last fall. The only thing I built in 52 years is a house in Bakersfield she lives in with the new guy. Country and sports talk fill the miles. Downgraded from Premium to Standard on April 14 — ads or not, cheaper is cheaper on a dedicated route.
Posted in truckers' playlist-swap thread: 'Anybody got a Bakersfield-sound playlist long enough for the Van Horn to Sierra Blanca run? That stretch is a killer.'
Downgraded April 14. Kept the app because the audiobook queue is the only thing that gets me through eleven hours. Skip most of the new music now, it all sounds the same from the cab.

5K run to synthwave, better than yesterday. Laid off from the fintech in October, still job-searching. Video-game soundtracks while I write cover letters — the game-OST community on the board is honestly where I feel most normal these days.
Posted in game-OST community: 'Which score do you all put on for grinding through applications? I've worn out the same three synthwave albums.'

Six months since the layoff. People at church think I'm 'taking time' on purpose. The game soundtracks are the one steady thing — I keep the Premium plan even when money's tight because the OST community is basically my coworkers now.
Posted in game-OST community: 'Phone screen Tuesday. Ran 8K to celebrate. Building a hype playlist — sci-fi series scores welcome.'

Defense in 19 days. Wrote committee responses till 1, then put on comfort-rewatch sitcoms to wind down. I run a small K-pop fan-translation account linked to my profile. It's the one thing that isn't the dissertation.
Posted from the fan-translation account: 'New comeback subs going up tonight — sorry for the delay, defending my PhD in three weeks!'

Triple-decker's loud after midnight with both roommates home. Worked at the kitchen table streaming K-pop low. Downgraded to the free ad-supported tier on the 18th — can't do the full price on the stipend. The ads are brutal but I only really need the duration and the queue.
Advisor sent edits at 11pm again. Trying to keep the rule: read them at 8 AM with coffee, not at 1 AM with a K-pop playlist and a spiraling brain. Free tier does the job for now.
